done_when: The host hook commands forge sync writes for Codex and Claude Code find forge even when the hook's PATH lacks uv's tool folder: they add uv's default tool bin folder (XDG_BIN_HOME, else HOME/.local/bin) to the front of PATH before running forge, and still block (exit 2) when forge can't be found at all. A command-level test runs each synced hook command with PATH=/usr/bin:/bin and a HOME whose .local/bin holds forge, and it runs; another with no forge anywhere still blocks. Forge's own repo's hook files are regenerated.
why: Codex runs its hooks with a PATH that lacks the folder uv installs forge into, so every hook command fails with 'forge: command not found' and the fail-closed deny hook blocks every shell command, even pwd, for a Codex orchestrator
